note: Tahoe NF campground on the banks of the Little Truckee River, a catch-and-release fly-fishing stream, between Boca and Stampede reservoirs off Stampede Meadows Rd north of Hirschdale (I-80); sparse pines, little shade. The nearest drinking water is at Boca Rest Campground. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: $20 (+$10 extra vehicle, 6-person cap), 12 sites (8 take RVs, 30-60 ft; 4 tent), 001 FCFS and FCFS-only from late Sept, season 05-22 to 10-11, 14-night max, vault toilets, no water. WATERFRONT: riverview -> recommend creekside (river ~20 m wide; 001-003/005/007 8-12 m from the water, 2.3-3.2 m above). Phone and website filled.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'riverview' (not --AWH) -> recommend 'creekside' (an upgrade - reported, AWH decides). The Little Truckee at the campground is ~20 m wide (3DEP water flat ~20 m between banks; under the ~30 m riverfront line), so riverfront/riverview are the wrong size class. Sites 001 (39.438232,-120.088634; FCFS, 60 ft), 002 (39.438110,-120.088784; 40 ft), 003 (39.437997,-120.088962; 30 ft), 005 (39.437752,-120.089340; 50 ft) and 007 (39.437621,-120.089672; 50 ft, RV/trailer/fifth wheel only) line the river edge: 3DEP puts the pads 2.3-3.2 m above the water flat at 8-12 m (~25-30% bank), with a fringe of willows/shrubs and a few pines on the bank and nothing else between - the Caledonia 655 creekside case (2.2-2.75 m over 21-28%, an easy walk down). All take a 23-ft rig and are sold by the night (001 first come). rec.gov: 'situated on the banks of the Little Truckee River'. Proposed evidence: 'rec.gov 234113 points vs Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: river ~20 m wide; 001-003, 005, 007 2.3-3.2 m above the water at 8-12 m over a ~25-30% willow-fringed bank (easy walk down); 009-012 on the inner side of the loop.' If AWH reads the willow fringe as a screen, the value stays riverview-equivalent at best (no 'creekview' exists) - then keep riverview.
